propositions: sign_manifest's generation loop treats transient store-read-failure from pre-lock reads (tracker_head_sha/collect) as terminal, immediately raising PlanReviewGenerationError, while a sibling moving-HEAD transient is retried within MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS

concurrent sessions writing to the shared .git/index cause peer staging windows (git add->commit mid-flight) that make git status non-empty, triggering store-read-failure in the pre-lock preflight reads

store-read-failure is asymmetrically handled: moving-HEAD transients are retried and exhaust to retryable PlanReviewGenerationRetryable, but pre-lock store-read-failure is terminal, blocking non-force close paths

the fix retries transient store-read-failure within the existing MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS loop (mirroring the moving-HEAD path), surfacing persistent failures as PlanReviewGenerationRetryable rather than terminal abort
deterministic PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons (missing/malformed/reducer/id-mismatch) remain terminal as retrying cannot fix them, and the authoritative under-lock re-check acts as a safety fence
